d: League of Legends League of Legends, often shortened to LoL, is a multiplayer online video game developed and published by Riot Games. It was first released in 2009 and has become one of the most popular competitive games in the world. League of Legends is a MOBA, which stands for “Multiplayer Online Battle Arena.” In the game, two teams of five players compete against each other with the main objective of destroying the enemy team’s base, called the Nexus. Before a match begins, every player chooses a character called a champion. There are many different champions, and each one has their own abilities, strengths, weaknesses, and playstyle. Some champions are designed to deal large amounts of damage, while others can protect their teammates, control enemies, heal allies, or absorb damage. Players can choose champions that match their preferred way of playing. A standard game takes place on a map called Summoner’s Rift. The map has three main paths, known as lanes: the top lane, middle lane, and bottom lane. Between these lanes is an area called the jungle. Each player usually has a specific role. The five main positions are Top, Jungle, Mid, Attack Damage Carry (ADC), and Support. Working together as a team is extremely important because each role has different responsibilities. During a match, champions become stronger by gaining experience and gold. Experience allows champions to level up and improve their abilities, while gold can be spent on items that increase their power. Players gain gold by defeating enemy minions, champions, and certain monsters. Minions are small units that regularly travel down the lanes and attack enemy structures. The map also contains defensive structures called turrets. Teams must destroy enemy turrets and other structures to reach the opposing Nexus. However, simply attacking the enemy base is rarely enough. Players have to make strategic decisions about when to fight, when to retreat, which objectives to take, and how to work with their teammates. League of Legends also has powerful neutral objectives, including monsters such as Dragons and the Baron Nashor. Defeating these objectives can give a team important advantages. Because of this, teams often compete over them, creating large battles that can completely change the outcome of a game. One of the most important aspects of League is its enormous amount of strategy. Players need to understand their own champion, recognize what enemy champions can do, manage resources, watch the map, communicate with teammates, and make decisions quickly. Even a small mistake can sometimes give the opposing team an advantage. League of Legends has also become a major esport. Professional players compete in leagues and tournaments around the world, with large audiences watching matches online and in arenas. Riot Games regularly updates the game with balance changes, new champions, skins, events, and other content. Overall, League of Legends is a team-based strategy game that combines fast gameplay, character abilities, competition, and long-term decision-making. Its large champion roster and constantly changing gameplay give players many different ways to play, which is a major reason why it has remained popular for so many years. #iqmaxx #fyp #sinister #rr #targetaudience

Counter-Strike 2 players have discovered that in-game chat logs are publicly searchable online, and the implications are significant.  A website has emerged that allows anyone to search through CS2 in-game messages by Steam ID, username, or keyword, pulling up everything players have typed in match chat going back months.  The discovery has caused immediate concern across the community, with streamers and professional players particularly exposed - their Steam IDs are publicly known, meaning anyone can pull up their entire match chat history with minimal effort.  Messages sent in what players assumed was a private or semi-private game environment are now fully accessible to the public with no opt-out mechanism currently available. The condition of the victims, aged 15 to 18, ranged from non-life-threatening to serious. In some parts of Southeast Asia, people believe the dead can return… still wrapped in their burial cloth. The Pocong is one of the most well-known spirits in Indonesian and Malaysian folklore. According to local beliefs, it is the ghost of a person who was buried in a traditional funeral shroud and whose spirit was unable to move on. In these burials, the body is wrapped tightly in white cloth and tied at the head, neck, and feet. Legends say that if the ties are not properly released after burial, the spirit may become trapped and return as a Pocong. Because its legs are bound by the cloth, the Pocong is often described as moving by hopping rather than walking. Many people claim to have seen these white figures at night near graveyards, forests, or abandoned roads. Even though there is no scientific evidence, the legend continues to be one of the most famous paranormal stories in Southeast Asia.

Dalam kepercayaan mistis Jawa, pocong dianggap sebagai roh yang terikat tali kafan karena belum “diantar pulang” sepenuhnya. Ia ingin menunjukkan keberadaannya, bukan sekadar menakuti. Diam sejenak, menundukkan kepala, dan mengucap salam atau doa singkat dipercaya sebagai cara memberi penghormatan kepada roh yang tersesat itu, agar tidak merasa terganggu oleh ketakutan manusia. Konon, jika seseorang langsung berlari tanpa menahan rasa paniknya, roh pocong akan merasa “diikuti” getaran takut itu dan menempel pada tubuh manusia, membuatnya mengalami mimpi buruk atau rasa berat di bagian tertentu ketika bangun tidur. Jika setelah menunduk dan memberi salam, pocong tidak bergerak, cukup mundur perlahan tanpa membelakangi, karena menurut mitos, membelakangi roh berarti membuka punggung untuk “ditunggui”. รหัสลับคัมภีร์เซน Ep.1: เปิดรหัสแห่งการตื่นรู้ในวัชรปรัชญาปารามิตาสูตร ​ยินดีต้อนรับสู่ตอนแรกของซีรีส์ "รหัสลับคัมภีร์เซน" ที่จะพาคุณเจาะลึกความลึกลับและแก่นแท้แห่งปัญญา! ​ใน Ep.1 นี้ เราจะเริ่มต้นด้วยการ เปิดเนื้อหาและรหัสแห่งการตื่นรู้ ที่ซ่อนอยู่ใน คัมภีร์วัชรปรัชญาปารามิตาสูตร (Diamond Sutra) หนึ่งในคัมภีร์ที่สำคัญที่สุดของพุทธศาสนามหายานและเป็นรากฐานของนิกายเซน (Zen) ​คุณจะได้เรียนรู้และเข้าใจ: ​ความสำคัญของ "ความว่าง" (Śūnyatā) ในบริบทของคัมภีร์ ​แนวคิดเรื่อง "การไม่ยึดมั่น" ในทุกสรรพสิ่ง ​รหัสลับที่พระพุทธเจ้าถ่ายทอด เพื่อให้เราก้าวข้ามความจริงสมมติ (Conventional Truth) ไปสู่ความจริงสูงสุด (Ultimate Truth) ​วิธีนำคำสอนอันลึกซึ้งนี้มาประยุกต์ใช้เพื่อการ "ตื่นรู้" (Enlightenment) ในชีวิตประจำวัน และการหลุดพ้นจากความทุกข์ ​คัมภีร์วัชรปรัชญาฯ ไม่ใช่แค่ตำราเก่าแก่ แต่เป็น แผนที่นำทางสู่การตระหนักรู้ ที่รอให้คุณมาถอดรหัส ติดตามการตีความเชิงลึกที่จะช่วยไขความกระจ่างในทุกประโยคของพระสูตร เพื่อให้คุณสามารถเข้าถึง "ปัญญาอันบริสุทธิ์" ได้ด้วยตัวคุณเอง ​อย่าพลาด! กดติดตามและกดกระดิ่ง เพื่อไม่พลาดการถอดรหัสลับในตอนต่อไป #วัชรปรัชญาปารามิตาสูตร #พระสูตรเพชร #รหัสลับคัมภีร์เซน #นิกายเซน #DiamondSutra @Dr.Thanik @Dr.Thanik @Dr.Thanik

Dancing across cultures: Odissi meets Balinese dance 🇮🇳🪷🇮🇩 the classical dance forms of Indonesia, Thailand, and Cambodia have uniquely incorporated Odissi-inspired mudras due to historical connections while adding their own cultural flourishes: 1) Indonesia (Balinese Dance): In Balinese dance, the influence of Odissi's mudras merges seamlessly with indigenous Indonesian elements, resulting in a dance form that is both technically precise and deeply rooted in Balinese culture. Dancers skillfully execute Odissi-inspired mudras alongside dynamic body movements and expressive facial expressions, creating a mesmerizing fusion of Indian and Balinese aesthetics.  The incorporation of Balinese music, mythology, and ritualistic practices adds layers of cultural richness and vibrancy to Balinese dance performances, making them uniquely beautiful in their own right. 2) Thailand (Khon): Thai classical dance, known as Khon, adopts Odissi's mudras as a foundation while infusing the performances with distinctively Thai characteristics. Dancers masterfully interpret Odissi-inspired mudras within the context of Thai literature, history, and mythology, adding layers of symbolism and meaning to each gesture.  The elaborate costumes, intricate footwork, and refined movements inherent in Khon performances reflect the elegance and sophistication of Thai culture, resulting in a dance form that is both aesthetically captivating and culturally resonant. 3)Cambodia (Khmer Classical Dance): In Khmer classical dance, Odissi's mudras are gracefully woven into the fabric of Cambodian culture, enriching performances with layers of symbolism, spirituality, and artistic expression. Dancers utilize Odissi-inspired mudras to convey emotions, depict characters, and narrate stories from Hindu and Khmer traditions, while incorporating Khmer musical rhythms and stylized movements that are unique to Cambodian dance.  The elaborate costumes, intricate choreography, and refined gestures characteristic of Khmer classical dance showcase the timeless beauty and cultural heritage of Cambodia, making it a truly captivating art form. Overall, the classical dance forms of Indonesia, Thailand, and Cambodia demonstrate how Odissi-inspired mudras have been adapted and reinterpreted to reflect the unique cultural identities and artistic sensibilities of each region. By blending Indian influences with indigenous traditions, these dance forms have evolved into vibrant expressions of Southeast Asian culture, embodying the beauty, diversity, and creativity of the region. #india #indian #indonesia #indonesia #bali #balinese #dance #odissi #explorepage #fyp #CapCut

Dalam unggahannya, Denada tampak mengenakan piyama dan melakukan hal-hal sederhana dengan canggung, seperti kesulitan menyalakan kompor, mencuci jamur enoki, hingga merobek sawi. Kehebohan bertambah setelah presenter Sarah Sechan ikut berkomentar dan merasa heran karena teringat Denada pernah terlihat lihai membuat sop ayam di konten lamanya. Pelantun lagu "Sambutlah" itu mengakui bahwa ekspresi bingungnya bukan rekayasa atau gimmick, melainkan karena ia memang tidak berbakat dan memasak bukan passion-nya. Menariknya, netizen kemudian menemukan video lama Denada saat mengikuti kompetisi memasak profesional dalam acara stasiun TV "Perang Dapur". Dalam video tersebut, Denada justru terlihat cukup piawai menggunakan peralatan dapur dan memasak dengan percaya diri. Resep Ayam Goreng Padang (untuk 8 porsi) Bahan marinasi: 2 ekor ayam pejantan utuh 1 buah jeruk nipis bumbu halus Bahan bumbu halus: 6 siung bawang putih 2 sdt ketumbar 4 cm jahe, iris 4 cm kunyit, iris 8 cm lengkuas, iris 5 lembar daun jeruk, buang batang 2 sdt garam 2 sdt kaldu ayam bubuk ¼ sdt merica 1 sdt penyedap 75 gr kelapa parut 4 sdm tepung beras 2 butir telur Bahan sambal cabe ijo: 100 ml minyak 15 siung bawang merah 160 gr cabai hijau, potong 2 buah tomat hijau, iris 5 lembar daun jeruk 1 sdt garam 1 sdt penyedap Pelengkap: nasi putih timun, kupas jeruk nipis Cara membuat: 1. Untuk bumbu halus, siapkan blender dan masukkan bawang putih, ketumbar, jahe, kunyit, lengkuas, daun jeruk, garam, kaldu ayam bubuk, merica, penyedap, kelapa parut, tepung beras dan telur, lalu haluskan 2. Potong ayam menjadi empat bagian dan buang kulitnya. Marinasi ayam dengan perasan jeruk nipis dan bumbu halus, aduk merata. Diamkan minimal 1 jam di suhu ruang atau semalaman di kulkas 3. Goreng ayam yang sudah dimarinasi di minyak panas dengan api sedang hingga matang kecokelatan, angkat dan tiriskan 4. Untuk tambahan serundeng, goreng sisa bumbu marinasi hingga kuning keemasan lalu angkat dan tiriskan 5. Untuk sambal cabe ijo, panaskan minyak sisa menggoreng ayam, lalu masukkan bawang merah dan cabai hijau yang sudah dipotong, tumis hingga layu. Siapkan food chopper dan masukkan tumisan bawang merah dan cabai hijau, lalu haluskan sesaat 6. Tumis tomat hijau dengan minyak sisa tumisan bawang dan cabai. Tambahkan daun jeruk dan bahan sambal yang sudah dihaluskan, tumis sesaat. Tambahkan garam dan penyedap, aduk rata 7. Ayam Goreng Padang siap disajikan

Nasi Goreng Indonesia - Indonesian Fried Rice #friedrice #easyrecipes #recipe  Ingredients 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 egg 3 cups cooked rice 4 slices fish cake, thinly sliced 4 large prawns, peeled and deveined A handful of fresh squid, cleaned and sliced 1 tbsp light soy sauce 2 tbsp kecap manis (sweet soy sauce) 1 tsp dark caramel sauce 1 tbsp sambal (adjust to taste) Large pinch of YumYum or MSG 1 bird’s eye chili, finely sliced 1 spring onion, thinly sliced 2 tbsp fried garlic Sliced cucumber and tomato, to serve Fried egg, to serve INSTRUCTIONS 1. Heat a wok over high heat and add a splash of oil. Add the minced garlic and stir-fry until fragrant. 2. Crack in the egg and scramble it quickly, breaking it into small pieces as it cooks. 3. Add the cooked rice to the wok and toss thoroughly, breaking up any clumps and ensuring it’s well-coated in the egg and garlic mixture. 4. Add the fish cake, prawns, and squid. Toss everything together and stir-fry until the seafood is cooked through. 5. Mix in the light soy sauce, kecap manis, dark caramel sauce, and sambal. Stir well to evenly coat the rice and proteins with the sauce. 6. Toss in the bird’s eye chili and sliced spring onion. Stir-fry briefly to combine. 7. Sprinkle the fried garlic over the rice and give it one final toss. 8. Serve hot, garnished with sliced cucumber and tomato, and top with a fried egg.

Indonesian Chicken Porridge 🍗🍚 Since moving to Bali I’ve been loving Indonesian food, so we had to make our own version of one of the classics, Bubur Ayam Super comforting, packed with flavour and surprisingly easy to make! 👨‍🍳 Ingredients, makes 2 serves Porridge ✅ Rice, 200g / 7.1 oz ✅ Water, 600ml / 20 fl oz, plus extra if needed ✅ Bay Leaves, 3 ✅ Salt, to taste ✅ Butter, 1 tsp, optional Yellow Chicken Broth ✅ Chicken Breast, 350g / 12.3 oz ✅ Shallots, 8 ✅ Garlic Cloves, 5 ✅ Ginger, 6g / 0.2 oz ✅ Turmeric, 6g / 0.2 oz ✅ Galangal, 6g / 0.2 oz, optional for a more authentic flavour ✅ Ground Coriander, 1 tsp ✅ Lemongrass, 1 stalk ✅ Water, 500ml / 17 fl oz ✅ Salt, to taste ✅ Stock Powder, 1 to 2 tsp Toppings ✅ Shredded Chicken ✅ Spring Onion, sliced ✅ Fried Shallots, optional ✅ Boiled Eggs, 2 ✅ Prawn Crackers, optional 👉 Method 1. Rinse the rice, then add it to a saucepan with 600ml of water, the bay leaves and a little salt. 2. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer until the rice becomes very soft and starts to break down into a porridge consistency. Stir occasionally and add more water if needed. 3. Meanwhile, boil the chicken breast in water until about halfway cooked. Remove and set aside. 4. Blend or finely grind the shallots, garlic, ginger, turmeric, optional galangal and coriander until you have a smooth spice paste. 5. Lightly sauté the spice paste until fragrant. 6. Add the lemongrass and cook for another minute. Add the half cooked chicken breast and 500ml of water, then simmer until the chicken is fully cooked and the broth is fragrant and yellow. 7. Remove the chicken and shred it into small pieces. Season the broth with salt and stock powder to taste. 8. Divide the porridge between two bowls, spoon over the yellow broth and top with the shredded chicken, spring onion and boiled egg. Add fried shallots and prawn crackers if desired. Calories: 700 kcal | P: 55g | C: 91g | F: 12g per serve* *Macros exclude optional butter, galangal, fried shallots and prawn crackers. Enjoy! 🇮🇩👌

Martabak Manis: Cheesy and chocolatey Indonesian street pancake! RECIPE⬇️⬇️ Translated from DapurHasika on YouTube. Check her out for a video guide INGREDIENTS: 340 g all purpose flour 6 tbsp granulated sugar, or to taste 1/2 tsp salt 460 ml water 2 eggs 1/4 tsp vanilla extract  1 tsp baking soda 1 tsp baking powder Cheese, condensed milk, chocolate sprinkles, or any topping you like! A VERY nonstick pan METHOD: -in a bowl, mix the flour, sugar, and salt, until combined.  -Add water, and using an electric mixer (or a whisk), beat until combined into a thick but liquidy batter. Lumps are fine.  -Add the eggs, and beat. You want to strengthen the gluten and incorporate air, so beat for at least 5 minutes, I did 7 minutes with my mixer but more like 10 minutes with a whisk.  -It should now be completely smooth and increased in size -Whisk in vanilla, the baking soda, and powder. Beat again for 30 seconds and scrape the sides of the bowl to ensure it’s evenly distributed  -Get a VERY nonstick pan, rub a small amount of oil on the pan and wipe with a dry paper towel, to create an invisible film of oil -You can divide your batter into 3 even parts for an 8 inch. nonstick, or two parts for a 9-10 inch. Thinner pancake will not have a honeycomb.  -Heat over high heat. Splash some water on the pan. If it bounces and rolls on the surface, it’s ready for the batter. If it sputters and boils instantly, it’s not hot enough.  -pour the measured batter into the pan. Immediately rotate the pan to thinly coat the sides, about 1cm above the batter. -Return to the flame and turn the heat to medium.  -After about 1-2 minutes you should see many wet bubbles appearing on the top. At this point, you can choose to GENTLY sprinkle some sugar on the top, not too much as it can weight down the wet batter, and cover with a lid. Sugar is definitely not necessary. Then turn the heat to medium low.  -Throughout the process, monitor your pancake by smell and by looking at the thin layer to gauge what the bottom looks like. You can gently peek at the bottom of the pancake to see if it’s burning. After about 5-6 minutes, if the top looks dry, it’s ready.  -Carefully remove form the pan and add toppings -Enjoy! Tips:  Don’t be discouraged if the first pancake doesn’t work out. Use it as an opportunity to see what is going wrong. The heat needs to be hot at the beginning to encourage the formation of the honeycomb and the dry and crunchy crust. I think you want to have the heat as high as you can without burning the pancake for this recipe—cooking low and slow prevents the dramatic honeycomb. Similarly, the timing for making these will be different for everyone’s stove and pan size. So go by appearance and smell to see if it’s ready. #martabakmanis #dessert #indonesia #internationalfood

Resep Panada Tongkol Rica (untuk 12 pcs) Bahan adonan panada: 100 ml air hangat 6 gr ragi 15 gr gula pasir 300 gr tepung terigu protein sedang ½ sdt garam 1 butir telur 30 gr santan 25 gr margarin, lelehkan Bahan isian: 200 gr ikan tongkol kukus, suwir 1 sdt garam 1 ½ sdm gula pasir 1 sdt penyedap 80 ml minyak, untuk menumis Bahan bumbu halus tongkol rica: 10 siung bawang merah 4 siung bawang putih 4 cm jahe, potong 3 cm kunyit, potong 12 buah cabai rawit merah 2 buah cabai merah besar 60 ml air Bahan aromatik: 1 batang serai, geprek 2 lembar daun salam 1 lembar daun pandan 3 lembar daun jeruk Cara membuat: 1. Untuk adonan, buat larutan ragi dengan mencampurkan ragi dan gula pasir ke dalam air hangat, aduk kemudian diamkan sesaat 2. Siapkan mangkuk, tuangkan tepung terigu dan garam lalu aduk rata. Buat rongga di tengah mangkuk, kemudian tuangkan larutan ragi, telur, santan, dan margarin yang sudah dilelehkan, aduk hingga rata 3. Uleni adonan hingga permukaannya halus dan tidak lengket, bulatkan dan tutup dengan plastic wrap, istirahatkan selama 30 menit atau hingga mengembang 4. Untuk isian, siapkan blender lalu masukkan bawang merah, bawang putih, jahe, kunyit, cabai rawit merah, cabai merah besar, dan air, lalu haluskan 5. Panaskan minyak, masukkan bumbu halus bersama serai yang sudah digeprek, daun salam, daun pandan, dan daun jeruk. Tumis dengan api sedang-kecil hingga wangi 6. Masukkan tongkol suwir, garam, gula pasir, dan penyedap lalu aduk rata. Masak dengan api kecil hingga kering kemudian matikan api dan biarkan dingin 7. Buang gas pada adonan panada yang sudah mengembang, bagi adonan menjadi 12 bagian masing-masing berat 40-42 gr. Bulatkan adonan dan istirahatkan kembali selama 5-10 menit 8. Pipihkan adonan kemudian beri isian tongkol rica sekitar 20 gr. Lipat dan tutup adonan kemudian ulir bagian pinggir adonan hingga benar-benar rapat. Diamkan panada yang sudah dibentuk selama 10-15 menit sebelum digoreng 9. Goreng panada di minyak panas dengan api sedang-kecil selama 1 ½ menit di masing-masing sisi atau hingga matang kecokelatan 10. Panada siap disajikan

Resep Ayam Goreng Bawang Merah (untuk 3 porsi) Bahan marinasi: 300 gr paha ayam filet ½ sdm perasan jeruk limau ½ sdm kaldu ayam bubuk 1/8 sdt merica 1 sdt gula pasir 1 sdt bawang putih bubuk 2 sdt kecap ikan 4 sdm tepung tapioka 1 sdm air Bahan lainnya: 75 gr bawang merah 4 buah cabai rawit merah (opsional) 1 ½ sdt kaldu jamur 1 sdt gula pasir Bahan pelengkap: nasi putih timun Cara membuat: 1. Potong-potong ayam kemudian marinasi dengan perasan jeruk limau, kaldu ayam bubuk, merica, gula pasir, bawang putih bubuk, kecap ikan dan tepung tapioka, aduk rata 2. Tambahkan air, aduk rata. Diamkan minimal selama 15 menit 3. Iris bawang merah dan cabai rawit merah. Panaskan minyak, goreng bawang merah iris hingga sedikit kecoklatan, tiriskan dan biarkan minyak di wajan 4. Dengan minyak yang sama, goreng ayam yang sudah dimarinasi hingga matang lalu sisihkan minyak 5. Masukkan bawang merah goreng, cabai rawit merah, kaldu jamur, dan gula pasir, aduk rata 6. Ayam goreng bawang merah siap disajikan

Pernah nggak sih, pengen masakan rumahan yang sederhana tapi rasanya “wah”? 💯 Hari ini aku masak Ayam Acar Kuning… dan jujur, ini tipe lauk yang bikin nasi di rumah cepat habis. 🔥🍀 Rasanya? Gurih, sedikit asam, ada pedasnya juga. Balance banget. Ini bukan cuma masakan… tapi comfort food yang selalu bikin kangen rumah. 🏡 RESEP AYAM ACAR KUNING - By Rudy Choirudin 🍀 Bahan 1: • 500 Gr Ayam • 1/2 Saset Bumbu Desaku Marinasi • 1 Saset Desaku bawang putih bubuk • 1/2 SDT Ladaku merica bubuk • 2 SDM Tepung Maizena • 2 SDM Air Bahan 2: (blender/haluskan) • 8 buah Bawang Merah • 3 butir Kemiri Goreng • 3 Cm Jahe • 1 SDT Desaku kunyit bubuk • 1/2 SDT Ladaku merica bubuk • 1 SDT Garam • 3 SDM Air Bahan 3: • 4 SDM Minyak Goreng (untuk menumis) • 1 batang Serai • 2 lembar Daun Salam • 150 ml Air • 1 SDM Gula • 1 saset Desaku bawang putih bubuk Bahan 4: • 8 buah Cabe Rawit • 50 Gr Wortel (potong batang korek lebih tebal) • 50 Gr Timun (potong batang korek lebih tebal) • 1 SDT Cuka Cara Memasak: 1. Campur semua Bahan 1 ke dalam kontainer, kocok rata kemudian diamkan 30 menit. 2. Goreng Ayam sampai kuning keemasan, tiriskan. 3. Blender Bahan 2, sampai halus. 4. Panaskan Minyak, masukkan bumbu yang sudah dihaluskan (Bahan 2). Tumis sampai harum dan matang. 5. Tambahkan Serai dan Daun Salam, tumis sampai mengeluarkan aroma. 6. Masukkan 150 ml Air, aduk merata hingga kuah mulai mengental. 7. Tambahkan Gula dan Desaku bawang putih bubuk, aduk rata. 8. Masukkan cabe rawit dan wortel, tambahkan timun dan cuka, aduk sesaat. 9. Masukkan ayam goreng, masak sampai bumbu meresap dan ayam terlumuri bumbu. 10. Angkat dan hidangkan. 🎬 Resep dan Video lengkap tersedia di YOUTUBE & FACEBOOK saya : @ResepSatset_Rudy dan @BukuResepSatsetRudy #masakanrumahan #resepviral #fypindonesia #menuharian #masaksimple

d: Resepi Ikan Tenggiri Masak Asam Jangan lupa save. Bahan-bahan * 1 ekor ikan tenggiri (dipotong) * Serbuk kunyit secukupnya * Garam secukupnya * Minyak untuk menggoreng Bahan tumis * 5 biji bawang merah kecil (dibiarkan sebiji) * 3 ulas bawang putih (dihiris) * 1 tangkai cili besar hijau (dipotong kasar) * 2 tangkai cili padi merah (dipotong kasar) Bahan kuah * 1 cawan air asam jawa * Air secukupnya untuk kuah * 2 biji tomato (dipotong) * Sos tiram secukupnya * Garam secukup rasa * Serbuk perasa secukup rasa * Sedikit gula Cara Memasak 1. Gaulkan ikan tenggiri bersama serbuk kunyit dan garam, kemudian goreng hingga garing. Angkat dan ketepikan. 2. Panaskan sedikit minyak, kemudian tumis bahan tumis hingga naik bau dan sedikit layu. 3. Masukkan air secukupnya bersama 1 cawan air asam jawa. Biarkan kuah mendidih. 4. Masukkan sos tiram, garam, serbuk perasa dan sedikit gula. Kacau hingga sebati dan sesuaikan rasa. 5. Masukkan ikan tenggiri yang telah digoreng, kemudian biarkan kuah mereneh seketika supaya rasa lebih meresap. 6. Masukkan tomato dan masak sekejap hingga tomato sedikit lembut. 7. Tutup api dan sedia untuk dihidangkan bersama nasi panas. Tip: Jangan gaul terlalu kuat selepas masukkan ikan supaya isi tak mudah hancur. Kalau suka kuah lebih pekat, biarkan mereneh sekejap sebelum tutup api. Selamat Mencuba 😋 #resepi #ikantenggiri #masakdirumah

Resepi Ayam Cili Kering Jangan lupa save. Bahan-bahan * 7–8 ketul ayam * Serbuk kunyit secukupnya * Garam secukupnya * Minyak untuk menggoreng Bahan Tumis * 1 biji bawang besar (dihiris) * 3 ulas bawang putih (dihiris) * 5–6 tangkai cili kering (dipotong) * 2 tangkai daun kari Bahan Perasa * Sos cili secukupnya * Sos tiram secukupnya * Kicap manis secukupnya * Serbuk perasa secukupnya Cara-cara 1. Gaulkan ayam bersama serbuk kunyit dan garam hingga sebati. 2. Panaskan minyak dan goreng ayam hingga masak serta sedikit garing. Angkat dan ketepikan. 3. Gunakan minyak gorengan ayam tadi, kemudian masukkan bawang besar, bawang putih, cili kering dan daun kari. 4. Tumis hingga semua bahan garing dan naik bau. 5. Masukkan sos cili, sos tiram, kicap manis dan serbuk perasa. Gaul hingga semuanya sebati. 6. Masukkan ayam yang telah digoreng tadi dan gaul rata sehingga ayam bersalut dengan bahan tumisan dan sos. 7. Tutup api dan sedia untuk dihidangkan bersama nasi panas. Tip: Tumis cili kering dan daun kari hingga betul-betul naik bau supaya rasa lebih wangi. Selepas masukkan ayam, gaul sekejap sahaja supaya ayam kekal sedap dan tidak terlalu kering. Selamat Mencuba 😋 #lauksimple #resepi #ayamcilikering

Insiden tersebut diduga terjadi dua kali, yakni pada Rabu (9/9) sekitar pukul 23.00 WIB dan Kamis dini hari sekitar pukul 03.00 WIB. Ayah korban menyebut penganiayaan dilakukan oleh empat senior di asrama Polisi Militer TNI Angkatan Udara (Pomau) saat ini tengah melakukan penyelidikan terkait dugaan kekerasan yang dialami Serda AMF untuk mengungkap secara utuh kronologi serta fakta-fakta yang berkaitan dengan kejadian tersebut,” demikian keterangan TNI AU lewat akun Instagram @militer.udara, Jumat (11/9/2026). TNI AU menyampaikan dukacita yang mendalam atas meninggalnya Serda AMF pada Kamis (10/9). d: Hijazi mqalqal ( المقلقل الحجازي ) من الذ وصفات القليات عنا فالوطن العربي. طعم السنوت ( الكمون ) ياخذها لعالم ثاني. و احلى شي بهالسنوت انه مطحون هنا عنا بالسلطنة فمطاحن @shraa77  المكونات: - بصله - كم حبة ثوم - ٣ قرون فلفل - ٣ حبات طماط - كيلو لحم غنم مقطع قطع صغيره - ملح و فلفل اسود - نص ملعقة بودرة الثوم - ملعقة كمون مطحون من @al_shraa1972  Ingredients: - 1 onion - 3 cloves of garlic - spicy chilies optional - 1 kg chopped lamb cubes - salt & pepper - 1/2 tsp garlic powder - 1 tsp cumin powder - start by dicing the onion. Garlic. Chili and tomatoes. - in a pan. Render some of the lamb fat if you have any. If not just a tiny drizzle of oil. Add the onion and let it wilt a bit. - add the meat and give it a nice hot sear on high till it takes a bit of a color. Add the garlic. Chili. Salt & pepper. Garlic powder and the cumin powder. - let them sizzle on high for a couple of minutes. If your tomatoes aren’t too juicy and you feel the pan is too dry. Add a splash of water, cover the pan and let it cook on low heat for 30 minutes.  - once ready. The sauce should be nice and thick. And the meat is super tender. Garnish with some fresh chili. Have it with bread or rice a squeeze of lemon and enjoy. #food #cooking #meat #saudi #ksa #lamb #spicy #simple #easy  #مسقط #oman #مسقط_السيب_الخوض_معبيله_العذييه_بوشر_الانصب_مطرح_العامرات_الحيل_الباطنه_من_الجنوب_للشمال #سلطنة_عمان

เวลารู้สึกว่าชีวิตตัวเองล้มเหลว คนจีนหลายคนจะนึกถึงจูหยวนจางก่อน เพราะจุดเริ่มต้นของเขา แทบไม่มีอะไรให้เริ่มเลย เขาเกิดในครอบครัวชาวนาที่ยากจน พ่อแม่เสียชีวิตจากโรคระบาดตั้งแต่ยังเด็ก ไม่มีเงินแม้แต่จะฝังศพ ต้องบวชเป็นพระเพื่อให้มีข้าวกิน แต่สุดท้ายแม้แต่วัดก็ยากจนเกินกว่าจะเลี้ยงพระได้ เขาจึงต้องออกเร่ร่อนบิณฑบาต เดินขอข้าวจากหมู่บ้านหนึ่งไปอีกหมู่บ้านหนึ่งเพื่อประทังชีวิต คนจีนถึงชอบพูดว่า “ต่อให้จุดเริ่มต้นของคุณต่ำแค่ไหน ก็ยังสูงกว่าจุดเริ่มต้นของจูหยวนจาง” แต่สิ่งที่ทำให้คนจีนรักเขา ไม่ใช่แค่เพราะเขาเคยลำบาก แต่เพราะเขาเป็นคนที่โค่นราชวงศ์หยวนของมองโกล และสถาปนาราชวงศ์หมิงขึ้นมา สำหรับคนจีนจำนวนมาก นั่นไม่ใช่แค่การเปลี่ยนฮ่องเต้ แต่คือการที่การปกครองกลับมาอยู่ในมือของชาวฮั่นอีกครั้ง จึงทำให้จูหยวนจางถูกจดจำในฐานะ “ผู้กอบกู้แผ่นดิน” เวลาคนจีนเล่าเรื่องเขา จึงมักเล่าคู่กันเสมอ ด้านหนึ่งคือความเจ็บปวดของยุคปลายราชวงศ์หยวน อีกด้านคือ ชายคนหนึ่งที่เริ่มจากการเป็นพระเร่ร่อน ผู้บิณฑบาตหาอาหาร และทหารตัวเล็ก ๆ ก่อนจะขึ้นไปเป็นฮ่องเต้ คนจีนชอบเรื่องของจูหยวนจาง เพราะมันทำให้พวกเขาเชื่อว่า “จุดเริ่มต้นของชีวิต ไม่ได้เป็นตัวกำหนดจุดจบ” คุณอาจเปลี่ยนประวัติศาสตร์ของประเทศไม่ได้เหมือนจูหยวนจาง แต่คุณยังเปลี่ยนประวัติศาสตร์ของชีวิตตัวเองได้เสมอ.  #ฮ่องเต้ #ประวัติศาสตร์จีน #china #ภาษาจีน

d: ข้าวผัดปลาส้มฟัก เมนูจานเดียวที่อร่อยจนหยุดไม่ได้! ข้าวผัดปลาส้มฟัก ข้าวสวยหอมมะลิ 450 กรัม ไข่เป็ด 2 ฟอง ปลาส้มพัก 200 กรัม ผงข้าวผัด ครัวบ้านสวนทวี 1 ช้อนโต๊ะ หอมแดงไทยซอย 2 หัว พริกแดงซอย ใส่ตามชอบ ต้นหอมซอย 2 ต้น มะนาว สำหรับเสิร์ฟ แจกสูตร ข้าวผัดปลาส้มฟัก ทำง่ายรสชาติกลมกล่อม เมนูอร่อยที่ใครก็ทำตามได้ที่บ้านโดยใช้เวลาไม่นาน  วิดีโอนี้จะพาคุณไปเรียนรู้ วิธีทำข้าวผัด ที่เน้นความหอมของเนื้อปลาและความนัวที่เป็นเอกลักษณ์ เหมาะสำหรับมือใหม่หรือคนที่กำลังมองหาไอเดียทำอาหารจานเดียวแบบรวดเร็วแต่ได้คุณภาพเหมือนร้านดัง โดยในคลิปนี้เราได้คัดสรรขั้นตอนการเตรียมวัตถุดิบและเทคนิคการผัดให้ข้าวเรียงเม็ดสวยงามมาให้คุณแล้ว  สำหรับใครที่ชื่นชอบ เมนูอาหารไทย รสชาติจัดจ้านและมีความเปรี้ยวเค็มกำลังดีจาก ปลาส้มฟัก รับรองว่าสูตรนี้จะกลายเป็นเมนูโปรดประจำบ้านของคุณอย่างแน่นอน เราเน้นการปรุงที่ใช้วัตถุดิบไม่ซับซ้อนแต่ได้รสสัมผัสที่ถึงเครื่อง พร้อมเคล็ดลับเล็กๆ น้อยๆ ที่จะช่วยให้การทำ ข้าวผัดปลาส้มฟัก ของคุณอร่อยยิ่งขึ้นกว่าเดิม  กดติดตามช่องของเราเพื่อรับชมสูตรอาหารเมนูใหม่ๆ ทุกสัปดาห์ และอย่าลืมคอมเมนต์บอกเราว่าคุณอยากให้ทำเมนูอะไรในคลิปถัดไป

d: 🇵🇭 Pork Adobo | Filipino Food Bible – Episode 1 My take on one of the most iconic Filipino dishes - Pork Adobo! This series will feature all filipino dishes in all their variations. consider this your guide to filipino cuisine. comment what you wanna see next! INGREDIENTS: Pork Adobo - 1.2 kg pork belly (or cut of choice) - 15–20 cloves garlic, minced (adjust to taste—more is always welcome) - 1 onion, chopped - 500 ml pork broth - 190 ml soy sauce - 100 ml cane vinegar - 3 long green chilies - 4 bay leaves - 1 tbsp whole peppercorns - 30 g palm sugar, chopped (adjust to sweetness) - Oil, for frying Toppings - Sliced onion leeks - Crispy garlic bits - Boiled eggs INSTRUCTIONS - Fry the pork until lightly browned on all sides, then remove and set aside. - In the same pot, sauté the garlic until lightly golden and fragrant. Add onions and cook until softened. - Return the pork to the pot, pour in the pork broth. Add the soy sauce, vinegar, green chilies, bay leaves, peppercorns, and palm sugar.  - Cover and let simmer on medium heat for 5-10 mins **don’t mix to allow vinegar to cook.  - Turn to low heat for 1–2 hours, until the pork is tender and the sauce has reduced. you want it to be almost swimming in its own fat like a confit - Optional: If serving with eggs, add the soft boiled eggs 2-3 mins before serving to retain jammyness - Serve over hot rice, topped with crispy garlic and leeks, and a hard-boiled egg on the side. Enjoy. #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood #asmr #cookingasmr #pinoyfood

Lechon Kawali silog 🐷🍳 Is it just me or Knorr Liquid Seasoning tastes good with almost everything? 🤔 When it comes to any silog meal - adding Knorr Liquid Seasoning to the rice, egg and ulam instantly makes it x10 better. I swear it can make the meals that we’re used to eating everyday even more exciting!!  Especially when you add it ito garlic rice?!! IT’S LIFE CHANGING #IfYouKnowYouKnorr. I’d love to see how you guys upgrade your ulam with Knorr liquid seasoning so please do tag me in your videos/posts🔥@Knorrph  INGREDIENTS: Crispy pork: - 1kg pork belly (sliced lengthwise) - 2 tbsp  Knorr liquid seasoning -  onion, garlic, bay leaves, peppercorns, salt Homemade atchara: - 1 green papaya, shredded - 1 small carrot, julienned - 1 onion, sliced - 2 green chillies, sliced - bay leaves/peppercorn - 1/4 cup raisins - Hot solution of equal parts vinegar and water with 2/3 cup sugar, 1 tsp turmeric and 1 tbsp salt Other ingredients: - Garlic fried rice with Knorr seasoning - Sunny Side up egg INSTRUCTIONS: -  Make crispy pork belly by boiling pork belly with onion, garlic, bayleaves, peppercorn, Knorr Liquid seasoning and salt for around 20-30mins. Rub with salt and let dry overnight in fridge. -  Air fry pork at around 175C for 40mins-1hr or until the skin is slightly hard but still has some resistance when you touch the skin. Remove and let cool. - In a pot with really hot oil >180C drop your pork belly pieces and cook for 3-5mins or until the skin is bubbly and crispy. Chop pork belly into cubes and set aside. - Make atchara by combining all the ingredients listed above along with your hot pickling solution. Leave in fridge overnight - Serve crispy pork bits with garlic rice, egg, atchara and enjoy! #foodph #pinoycooking #pinoycuisine #pinoyeats #IYKYK  #cookingasmr #asmr

🇵🇭 Kare Kare | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 10 Kare-kare is a rich Filipino stew made with oxtail, tripe, and vegetables, all simmered in a thick peanut sauce. It’s usually served with bagoong (fermented shrimp paste) on the side to balance the flavors and an extra level of umami and saltiness 😋 INGREDIENTS: Boiling liquid: - 1-2 red onions, chopped - 2 bulbs of garlic, chopped - 1 tbsp of salt - 1 tbsp peppercorns - 5-6 bay leaves - 1 kg of oxtail - 650g of ox tripe - Beef stock as needed Kare Kare: - 10g of annatto powder - 2 tablespoons oil - 15-20 cloves garlic, minced - 2 tbsp annatto powder - 1 white onion, diced - 1 banana heart, chopped, washed and rinsed w/ salt - Beef stock as needed - green beans, chopped - eggplants, quartered - pechay/bok choy - 1 ½ cup peanut butter - Patis to taste - ½ teaspoon salt - 1 tbsp of sugar (optional to taste) Toasted rice slurry: - 1:5 tbsp of water to toasted rice, blended Served with:  - Bagoong  - Crushed peanuts INSTRUCTIONS:  - Start by seasoning your meat with salt and pepper and sear. Add all ingredients under “boiling liquid” and fill the pot as needed with beef stock. Simmer until tender, remove meat and set aside the broth for later.  - Saute onions, garlic, and banana hearts in oil mixed with annatto powder. Add your meat back and cover with the broth from the boiling liquid and simmer for 15-20 minutes. - To thicken the mixture, add toasted rice to a food processor or blender. Take some of the rice and mix with water to form our slurry.  - Add both rice slurry and peanut butter stir and reduce to thicken. Season with patis/salt/pepper and add your vegetables.  - Serve alongside bagoong top and enjoy!  #CookingASMR #ASMR #FilipinoFood #PinoyFood

Episode 5: Homemade Garlic Longganisa 🇵🇭 (Pinoy-Style) Ingredients:  900 g ground pork 150 g pork fat (optional) 20 cloves garlic, finely minced 1/4 cup brown sugar 1 1/2 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp white vinegar 1 tsp paprika 2 tbsp cornstarch 1 tbsp salt 1 tbsp black pepper Natural hog casing  Kitchen twine Procedure:  1. Rinse and soak the hog casing in water for 1 minute. Drain well. 2. Mix the ground pork, garlic, sugar, soy sauce, vinegar, salt, pepper, paprika, cornstarch, and cold water until sticky and well combined. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours 3. Stuff the mixture into the casing, being careful not to overfill. Twist and tie with kitchen twine. 4. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight to slightly dry the casing. Then freeze overnight. 4. To cook, place the longganisa in a pan with ¼ cup water. Cover and cook over medium heat until the water evaporates. Add 1–2 tbsp oil and fry until golden brown and cooked through, reaching 71°C / 160°F internally. You can add any seasoning but make sure you mix it well with the meat! Pwede adobo flavor or any. 🇵🇭 Beef Salpicao | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 12 My take on a delicious FIlipino-Spanish dish usually made with tender beef cubes cooked in garlic, butter and Worcestershire sauce — but with extra garlic flavor!  * this recipe is only a guideline. most ingredients are just estimates so taste and adjust with your ❤️ INGREDIENTS: Beef salpicao: - 500g ribeye steak (or any cut of steak of your choice) - 300g of button mushrooms - Salt and pepper to taste - Oil for frying - 1/4 block of butter - 15-20 cloves of garlic, minced - 3 tbsp of Worcestershire sauce  - 1  tbsp of oyster sauce  - 2 tbsp of paprika  Garlic confit: - 300g of peeled garlic cloves - Olive Oil to cover Garnish: - parsley - crunchy garlic - pickled peppers INSTRUCTIONS: - Start by seasoning your steak and grilling until medium rare. Slice them into bite sized chunks and set aside for later - Slice button mushrooms. In a pan , add oil and/or butter, sauté the button mushrooms until they get deeper in color. Season with salt and pepper.  - Add minced garlic to a hot pan with oil and butter, and saute unti fragrant. Add back your steak and mushroom and add Worcestershire sauce, oyster sauce, paprika and black pepper. - To make it extra garlicky, we’re adding some garlic confit. To make it, simply add peeled garlic to a pot, cover with oil, and cook low and slow until the cloves are soft and golden. - Serve with garlic rice and enjoy! #CookingASMR #ASMR # FilipinoFood #pinoyfood

🇵🇭 Chicken Pyanggang | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 14 Link in bio for my mom’s restaurant! 💜 Pyanggang is easily one of my favorite and most iconic Tausug dishes. Its “blackness” comes from charred coconut, giving you this rich, spicy, smoky coconut flavor unlike anything else! *Disclaimer: The term bible in the title is not used in a religious context, it’s to denote a collection of recipes :)  INGREDIENTS: Siyunog Lahing: - 2 mature coconuts, sun dried/roasted    Pamapa Itum: - 240-250g of siyunog lahing - 150g red onions - 1 head of garlic - 2 tbsp ginger - 2 tbsp turmeric  - 3-4 stalks of lemongrass, sliced - Red chili, to taste - 2 tsp of salt - 2 tsp black pepper Stewing Liquid: - Marinated chicken quarters - 2 red onions - 10-15 cloves of garlic - 1 tbsp of ginger, chopped - 3-4 stalks of lemongrass - red chili, to taste - 2 tbsp pamapa itum - 4 cans coconut milk - 2 tbsp fish sauce (optional) Sulu Style Sambal: - 3 tbsp of oil - 1 red onion - 1 head of garlic - 2 inches of ginger, minced - red chili to taste - 2 tbsp shrimp paste/alamang  - ½ kg tomatoes, chopped - 400 ml of coconut milk - 1 tbsp sugar - Pepper tp taste Turmeric Rice: - 3 cups washed rice - 3 ¼ cup water - 2 tsp turmeric powder - ¼ cup coconut milk INSTRUCTIONS: - Roast the dried coconut until charred w/ little brown in the center, grind in blender/mortar. - Make pamapa itum by mixing siyunog lahing w/ aromatics. Coat chicken lightly and marinate overnight. - For the pyanggang, sauté the aromatics under “pamapa itum” add coconut milk, add chicken and simmer on low for 30-40mins until cooked - Remove chicken and reserve liquid for basting. Add fish sauce and reduce. Grill the chicken, basting as you go, until nicely charred. - For the sambal, sauté all ingredients under “sulu style sambal”.  pour in the coconut milk. Season w/ pepper and sugar, and continue cooking until oils begin to separate. - Cook the turmeric rice with the water, turmeric, and coconut milk. - Serve everything together and enjoy! #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood #asmr #cookingasmr #tausug

Misua 🍜 Filipino noodle soup with ground pork and sponge gourd  You can disagree all you want, but to me, misua is the best Filipino noodle soup.. but that’s just my opinion. The name misua refers to the type of noodles used, and these aren’t your typical noodles. They are made out of wheat and are very thin and delicate. Its origins come from China brought to the Philippines through generations of Chinese Filipino cultural exchange. When cooked it becomes soft and silky texture, not to mention it cooks extremely fast. It also slightly thickens the broth as it cooks. Misua has different versions but this one is probably the simplest. Save this post 📍I’ve put the recipe is below! Follow me @krizkitch for more Filipino and Asian recipes, ingat!  Ingredients: 1/2 Tbsp neutral oil 1/2 onion, minced 4 cloves garlic, minced  1/2 lb ground pork 1 tsp shrimp or chicken bouillon powder 32 oz chicken bone broth  2 patola, peeled and cut into 1/2 in slices 4 oz misua (Chinese vermicelli) Salt pepper fish sauce  Instructions: Heat oil in a medium pot, add in onions and garlic. Saute until onions are translucent and garlic is fragrant. Add in ground pork, saute until browned and no longer pink. Add bouillon powder. Add in chicken broth. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Add in patola. Cook for another 5 minutes. Add in misua noodles, stir. Cook for another 2-3 minutes or until noddles are soft. Season with salt and pepper and fish sauce to taste.  #filipinofood #misua #filipinosoup #noodlesoup

Ginataang Manok  Ingredients: 4 Chicken thighs and 4-6 drumsticks Kosher salt for seasoning the chicken 1/2 onion, sliced 3 cloves garlic, minced 3/4 Cup water 2 Cans coconut milk 1 Anaheim Pepper 3 Fresno chillies (optional) use 1-2 Thai chili if you like it spicy 1 Chicken Bouillon Cube 1 Tbsp Black pepper 1 Tbsp Fish sauce 40g Ginger, cut in slices 1 Large potato 1 Large Carrot Bok Choy Instructions 1. Season the chicken generously with kosher salt. For the best flavor, refrigerate and let it season overnight. 2. Heat a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken skin-side down until golden brown and the fat has rendered, about 5–7 minutes. Flip and cook for 1 more minute, then remove from the pot. 3. In the same pot, sauté the onions for 2–3 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. 4. Pour in the water and coconut milk, then stir in the ginger, bouillon cube, fish sauce, and black pepper. Return the chicken to the pot. 5. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook uncovered over medium-low heat for 15 minutes. 6. Add the potatoes, carrots, and Fresno chilies (if using). Continue simmering for another 15 minutes, or until the vegetables are fork-tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. 7. Taste the broth and adjust the seasoning if needed. 8. Serve hot with steamed white rice. #ginataangmanok #filipino #recipe #food #easyrecipe

Crockpot Beef Adobo 🥩🔥 Crockpot Series Episode 3: Beef Adobo. This is my crockpot series, where I help you make easy recipes so good you might find a spouse or impress the one you got. This beef adobo is packed with flavor but incredibly easy to make. The short ribs cook low and slow in a sweet, savory and tangy adobo sauce until tender, then get one final blast of heat for those sticky, caramelized edges. 🔥 Ingredients: 3 lb flanken-cut short ribs 1–1½ tsp SPG seasoning 1 medium onion, sliced ½ cup shoyu ⅓ cup cane vinegar or apple cider vinegar ⅓ cup brown sugar ¼ cup water 2 Tbsp oyster sauce 1 Tbsp sesame oil 2 Tbsp minced garlic 1 tsp lightly crushed black peppercorns 1 tsp ground black pepper 3 bay leaves For the slurry: 1 Tbsp cornstarch 2 Tbsp cold water Garnish: Crispy garlic Sliced green onions Instructions: 1. Rinse the short ribs if needed, then pat them completely dry. Optional: Season lightly with SPG. 2. Sear the ribs in a hot skillet for 1–2 minutes per side, just until browned. 3. Arrange the ribs in the crockpot then top with the sliced onions. 4. Mix the shoyu, vinegar, brown sugar, water, oyster sauce, sesame oil, garlic, peppercorns and ground pepper. Pour it over the ribs and add the bay leaves. 5. Cover and cook on LOW for 5–6 hours or HIGH for 3–4 hours, until tender. Flanken ribs are thin, so check them early to keep them from completely falling apart. 6. Transfer the ribs to a sheet pan. Skim the excess fat from the cooking liquid, then simmer the liquid in a saucepan for 5–10 minutes. 7. Mix the cornstarch and cold water, then whisk the slurry into the simmering sauce until glossy and lightly thickened. 8. Spoon the sauce over the ribs. 9. Serve over rice and finish with crispy garlic and sliced green onions. 🤤 It’s flavorful, tender and so easy—the crock pot did the work, but we’re taking all the credit 🙌 #mealprepideas #adobo #hawaiitiktok #crockpot #easyrecipe

Viralowe pierożki z patelni – chrupiące od spodu i obłędnie soczyste w środku! Jeśli lubisz azjatyckie smaki, koniecznie zapisz ten przepis. Z podanych składników przygotujesz 2 duże porcje. SKŁADNIKI: 20 płatów ciasta do pierożków dim sum 500 g mielonej wieprzowiny 1 marchewka duża garść szczypiorku 6 ząbków czosnku 1 łyżka startego imbiru 2 łyżki sosu sojowego 2 łyżki sosu ostrygowego 1 łyżka oleju sezamowego 1 łyżeczka cukru trzcinowego 1 łyżeczka soli 125 ml bulionu warzywnego PRZYGOTOWANIE: 1. Marchewkę zetrzyj, szczypiorek drobno posiekaj, a czosnek przeciśnij przez praskę. 2. Do mielonej wieprzowiny dodaj marchewkę, szczypiorek, czosnek i starty imbir. 3. Dodaj sos sojowy, sos ostrygowy, olej sezamowy, cukier trzcinowy i sól. Całość dokładnie wymieszaj. 4. Porcję farszu nakładaj na środek ciasta do dim sum i dokładnie zlepiaj pierożki. 5. Pierożki ułóż na patelni i podsmażaj na średnim ogniu przez około 2 minuty, aż spód zacznie się rumienić. 6. Wlej 125 ml bulionu warzywnego, przykryj patelnię i gotuj przez około 16 minut. 7. Zdejmij pokrywkę i gotowe! Najlepiej smakują polane olejem chili lub dodatkowym sosem sojowym. WARTOŚCI ODŻYWCZE NA 1 PORCJĘ: 825 kcal 62 g białka 39 g tłuszczu 57 g węglowodanów 4 g błonnika Chrupiący spód, miękkie ciasto i aromatyczny, soczysty farsz. Crispy Breakfast Quesadilla crispy, cheesy & loaded! 🌮🍳🥓 This Breakfast Quesadilla is the ultimate morning bite!  Ingredients ½ cup shredded cheddar cheese, divided 2 large eggs, beaten Salt & black pepper, to taste 1 large flour tortilla ¼ cup cooked breakfast sausage, crumbled 2 slices cooked bacon, sliced Instructions Heat a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat. Sprinkle half of the cheddar cheese directly onto the pan. Pour the beaten eggs over the cheese and season with salt and pepper. Immediately place the tortilla on top of the eggs. Gently press down and cook until the eggs are set. Flip everything over so the tortilla is on the bottom. Sprinkle the remaining cheddar cheese over one half of the tortilla. Top half quesadilla with cooked breakfast sausage and bacon. Fold to close the quesadilla. Cook for 1–2 minutes per side, flipping until both sides are golden and crispy and the cheese is melted. d: Arsenio’s Chicken Alfredo Mac N Cheese 👑🧀🍗 Chicken: 1 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp Cajun seasoning 1 tbsp black pepper 2 tsp salt Cube your chicken, season it, then cook it halfway on the stove before finishing it in the oven. Roux: ½ cup butter (113g) ½ cup flour (60g) 3 garlic cloves 1 chicken bouillon cube, grated Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp smoked paprika Melt the butter, add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Whisk in the flour and cook for 60–90 seconds. Add the grated chicken bouillon cube, then slowly add your milk and cream while whisking until it thickens. Sauce: 3 cups whole milk (720g) 1 cup heavy cream (240g) 3–4 cups shredded cheese (340–450g) — fontina, mozzarella, cheddar Take it off the heat and add your cheese 1 cup at a time until smooth. Pasta: 2 packs Barilla pasta (340g each) Boil the pasta just under al dente, drain and mix it into your cheese sauce. Add the chicken and mix everything together. Put it into a baking dish and cover the top with extra cheese… measure that with your eyes 😂 Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes, then broil on high for 3 minutes. Plate it up and finish with freshly grated Parmesan. 🧀

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Recipe Name Cheesy Crunchy Beef Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb (450 g) ground beef 2. 8 hard taco shells 3. 1 tbsp olive oil 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 2 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 packet (1 oz) taco seasoning 7. 1/2 cup water 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, shredded 10. 1/2 cup heavy cream 11. 2 oz cream cheese, softened 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp chili powder 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 1 diced tomato 16. 2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro Recipe 1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 2. Add the onion and cook until softened, then stir in the garlic. 3. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. 4. Drain excess grease and mix in the taco seasoning and water. 5. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. 6. In a small saucepan, melt the cream cheese with the heavy cream. 7. Stir in the cheddar, Monterey Jack, paprika, chili powder, and black pepper until smooth. 8. Fill each taco shell with the seasoned beef. 9. Spoon the warm cheese sauce over the beef. 10. Top with diced tomatoes and fresh cilantro. 11. Serve immediately while the shells stay crispy. Follow for more delicious recipes!

Recipe: Chicken Tenders • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to spice) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 sazon packet • 1–2 cups buttermilk • ⅛ cup jalapeño or pickle juice • 3 cups all-purpose flour (season with same seasonings) Hot Honey Sauce • ½ cup buffalo sauce • ¼ cup honey • ⅛ cup hot sauce (optional) Pasta • 1 lb penne pasta • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 2 garlic cloves, finely minced • ½ yellow onion, finely chopped • 1 ½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • Grated mozzarella • Grated Parmesan Instructions 1. Season chicken tenderloins add in buttermilk and jalapeño/pickle juice then marinate for at least 30 minutes to an hour.  2. Coat chicken in seasoned flour set aside on wire rack and rest for 10 minutes before frying. Fry at 350°F until golden brown and crispy. Set aside and let cool on a wire rack. 3. In a sauce pan, add 1 tbsp of unsalted butter, buffalo sauce, honey, and hot sauce and simmer until fully combined. Then toss chicken in the hot honey sauce. 4. In a skillet, melt butter and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and stir in all seasonings. 5. Chicken alfredo tacos 🌮  For the chicken 1 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  1/2 tsp Italian seasoning  2 tbsp lemon juice  2 tbsp oil for marinating + more for cooking For the Alfredo sauce: 2 tbsp butter 1 tbsp all purpose flour  2 cloves fresh garlic, minced  1 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream Salt to taste  1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1/2 cup milk 3/4 cup Parmesan cheese, freshly grated  To assemble  15-16 mini tacos 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for lightly frying the tacos 1/4 cup parsley, freshly chopped for garnish  Method  Marinate the chicken with salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, Italian seasoning, lemon juice, and oil for 20–30 minutes. Cook until golden and set aside. In the same pan, melt the butter and sauté the garlic. Whisk in the flour, then add the heavy cream and milk. Season with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder. Simmer until slightly thickened, then stir in the Parmesan until smooth.  Add the cooked chicken to half of the sauce and toss to coat. Reserve half for later . Fill each tortilla with mozzarella, the chicken Alfredo mixture, and a little more mozzarella. Fold and pan-fry until golden and crispy on both sides. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve with extra Alfredo sauce for dipping. #recipe #tacos #alfredochicken

Using my free will to cook meals in untraditional ways  This is a One Pot Skillet Lasagna (no oven required)  I used to avoid making lasagna because there’s nothing quick or easy about it. This time I made the whole thing in one pot, no layering, no oven, barely any thought required. Ingredients: 1/2 white onion, diced 6 to 8 garlic cloves, minced 2 lbs ground turkey 1 tbsp each: onion powder, garlic powder, basil, Italian seasoning, black pepper, salt (adjust to taste) 1 tsp red pepper flakes 2 jars tomato sauce 1 box lasagna noodles 2 cups water 1/3 cup ricotta cheese 6 to 8 large basil leaves 1 handful parmesan cheese Instructions: Sauté onion and garlic on medium heat for 5 minutes, until fragrant Add ground turkey and seasonings, cook through Stir in tomato sauce and let simmer on low for 45 minutes to 1 hour, stirring occasionally Add noodles and water, cover, and cook for 15 to 20 minutes, checking and stirring occasionally Stir in half the ricotta and the basil, sprinkle parmesan on top, cover and let simmer a few more minutes Serve and enjoy Skillet lasagna on the stove is officially my new go to. d: 💥bang bang chicken 🍗 Ingredients  1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs season to your hearts desire  salt and pepper onion powder  garlic powder  smoked paprika  Sauce 1/2 cup Kewpie mayo @Kewpieusa  3 tbsp sweet chili sauce  Sriracha to taste  1/2 tbsp lime juice  Instructions  1. Pre heat air fryer to 380°F. Clean and trim off excess fat from chicken thighs and pat dry. Place chicken on a baking sheet or mixing bowl, add seasonings to taste. Drizzle with oil and mix to thoroughly combine ensuring all sides are evenly coated. 2. Air fry chicken thighs at 380°F for 12 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway through. Cook until the thickest part of the chicken reaches internal temp of 165°F. 3. While chicken is cooking make the bang bang sauce. Reserve some sauce for topping. Brush remaining sauce to coat top of each chicken thigh. Crank heat up to 400°F or if you have the @From Our Place air fryer like me, switch it to low broil. Cook for an additional 5 minutes until sauce thickens.  4. Serve with rice, garnish with reserved sauce, parsley or chopped green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

honey chipotle chicken sandwiches ✨ i will be uploading a newer version of my bun recipe because i tweaked it a bit to make them even softer!  Ingredients  - 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast - 1 1/2 cups buttermilk  - 1/3 cup pickle juice - 1/4 cup hot sauce - 1 large egg - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder  - 1 1/2 tsp chipotle powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp mustard seed powder  - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - Salt and pepper to taste  Dredge - 1 1/2 cups all purpose flour  - 1/2 cup cornstarch  - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder - 1 tsp smoked paprika - 1 tsp chipotle powder - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - 1 sazon packet (optional) - 1/2 tsp mustard powder - Salt and pepper to taste  - Drizzle of marinade  Honey chipotle sauce - 1/2 cup honey - 3 tbsp chipotle peppers, blended - 1 tbsp unsalted butter - 2 tsp apple cider vinegar  - 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1/4 tsp smoked paprika  - Salt to taste Assembly - Brioche buns - Pickles - Ranch Instructions  - Cut/pound chicken into even sandwich-sized pieces and add to a large bowl. - Add butter milk, seasonings, 1 egg, pickle juice, hot sauce, and mix until well combined. Refrigerate for 3 hours minimum or overnight for best results. - Combine all dredge ingredients. Drizzle a little of the marinade into the flour and toss with spoon create those crispy, craggy pieces. - Remove chicken from the marinade and coat well in the dredge. Dip it back into the marinade, then into the dredge again, pressing the flour mixture firmly onto the chicken. Let the double-battered chicken rest for 10–12 minutes so the coating sticks. - Heat frying oil to 350°F. Fry chicken in batches until deeply golden and crispy and the center reaches 165°F. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. - For the honey chipotle sauce, add honey, blended chipotle peppers, butter, apple cider vinegar, garlic powder, smoked paprika and salt to a saucepan. Heat on low for 2–3 minutes, stirring until smooth and glossy. - Brush or drizzle the warm honey chipotle sauce over the freshly fried chicken. - Toast your brioche buns, add ranch, pickles, crispy honey chipotle chicken, and serve immediately.  • • • #recipe #recipeideas #chickenrecipe #sandwich

Steak Loaded Potato Skins🔥 For those of you asking about the app, just search “Osta” on the App Store or Google Play 🫶 Crispy, cheesy potato skins loaded with juicy steak, chipotle sour cream & fresh chives… 🤤 Inspo from the goats @chefmikekubiesa & @burnt_pellet_bbq !! For the Potatoes: -5 large russet potatoes -1/4 cup olive oil -1 tbsp salt For the Filling: -Scooped potato flesh -1/2 cup milk, warmed -1/3 cup butter, softened -1/2 cup sour cream -1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar, grated -1/4 cup fresh chives, chopped -Seasoning salt, to taste For Frying & Topping: -Neutral oil, for frying -Triple cheddar @tillamook, grated For the Steak: -Ribeye or New York strip -Salt & black pepper For the Chipotle Sour Cream (Optional): -1 cup sour cream -1–2 chipotle peppers in adobo -2 garlic cloves -1 tbsp lime juice -1/2 tsp salt -Milk, as needed Instructions: 1. Wash & dry potatoes. Rub with olive oil, season with salt & bake at 425°F (220°C) for 50–60 mins until fork-tender. Let cool slightly. 2. Meanwhile, blend all chipotle sour cream ingredients until smooth, adding a splash of milk to thin as needed. Refrigerate. 3. Halve potatoes lengthwise & scoop the flesh into a bowl, leaving about 1/4 inch around the skins. Mash with warm milk, butter, sour cream, cheddar, chives & seasoning salt to taste. 4. Heat neutral oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry the empty skins in batches for 2–3 mins until golden & crispy, then transfer to a wire rack. 5. Stuff the skins with the potato filling, top with triple cheddar & bake at 350°F (175°C) for 15 mins until bubbling & golden. 6. Season steak generously with salt & pepper, then grill or pan-sear to your desired doneness. Rest 5–10 mins, then slice against the grain into bite-sized pieces. 7. Load the skins with steak, chipotle sour cream & fresh chives. Enjoy!! #dinnerideas #cookingathometiktoktv #recipe #cooking

 1 can (14 oz) sweetened condensed milk
 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
 18–20 OREO cookies, chopped
 WHITE CHOCOLATE INNER COATING
 Ingredients
 4 oz white chocolate, chopped
 1 teaspoon coconut oil
 COOKIES & CREAM OUTER COATING
 Ingredients
 6 oz white chocolate, chopped
 6 oz Hershey’s Cookies ’n’ Creme bars, chopped
 1–2 tablespoons coconut oil, as needed for a smooth dipping consistency
 Optional: Make an additional batch of coating for a double-coated extra-crunchy shell.
 TOPPING
 Crushed OREO cookies
 Melted white chocolate, for drizzling
 INSTRUCTIONS
 MAKE THE WAFFLE CONE TACO SHELLS
 Whisk together the eggs and sugar until smooth.
 Add the melted butter and vanilla extract.
 Mix in the flour and salt until a smooth waffle cone batter forms. Add a small amount of milk if needed to loosen the batter.
 Cook the batter in a waffle cone maker according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
 While each waffle is still warm and flexible, gently shape it over a rolling pin to create a wide taco shell.
 Allow the shells to cool completely and become firm.
 COAT THE INSIDE
 Melt the white chocolate with the coconut oil until smooth.
 Using a pastry brush, coat the inside of each taco shell with a thin layer of white chocolate.
 Place the shells in the freezer just until the chocolate completely sets.
 This coating helps keep the waffle shell crisp once the ice cream filling is added.
 MAKE THE OREO ICE CREAM FILLING
 Add the cold heavy whipping cream to a mixing bowl.
 Whip until stiff peaks form.
 Gently fold in the sweetened condensed milk and vanilla extract.
 Fold in the chopped OREO cookies until evenly distributed.
 FILL THE TACOS
 Spoon or pipe the OREO ice cream mixture into each taco shell.
 Smooth the exposed top of the filling.
 Place the filled tacos in the freezer until the filling is firm, about 2–3 hours.
 MAKE THE COOKIES & CREAM COATING
 Combine the chopped white chocolate and Hershey’s Cookies ’n’ Creme bars.
 Melt until completely smooth.
 Stir in coconut oil a little at a time until the coating is thin enough for dipping.
 COAT THE OUTSIDE
 Dip or carefully coat the outside of each frozen taco with the cookies and cream chocolate mixture.
 Place on a parchment-lined sheet pan and return to the freezer until completely set.
 OPTIONAL EXTRA-CRUNCHY DOUBLE COATING:
 Once the first coating has hardened, dip the taco a second time in the cookies and cream chocolate mixture.
 Return to the freezer until the second coating is completely firm.
 FINISH THE CHOCO TACOS
 Dip the exposed top edge of each taco into the cookies and cream coating.
 Immediately sprinkle crushed OREO cookies over the chocolate before it sets.
 Return to the freezer until firm.
 Finish with a drizzle of melted white chocolate over the top.
 Freeze until completely solid before serving.

d: Cheesy Beef and Potato Soup  **Recipe** 2 lbs Ground beef  3 lbs Yukon Gold Potatoes 3 celery stalks  3 carrots  1 onion 3 to 4 cloves of garlic  4 cups beef broth  2 cups heavy cream  1/4 tbs of butter  1/4 cup of flour  1 beefy onion soup mix packet  8 oz Sharp cheddar  8 oz Sharp white cheddar  Chives (optional) Seasonings:  Black pepper  Smoked paprika  Italian seasoning  Nature's seasoning  Kinder's Caramelized Onion Butter  In a large dutch oven or pot, brown ground beef and drain any excess grease. Add seasonings. Add onions, carrots, and celery and cook until onions are softened and then add garlic. Cook for 1 to 2 mins and then add in beefy onion soup mix. Add butter and allow to melt, then add flour and stir for 2 to 3 mins. Add beef broth, bring to a gentle boil and add potatoes. Cover and cook 15 to 20 mins (or until potatoes are fork tender). Turn heat to low and add heavy cream, cheese, and chives. Mix well and serve.
